Model Text Summary:
A realistic narrative by Kamakshi Balasubramanian depicting the anxieties of Velu, a dedicated small farmer facing a devastating drought. As heat parches his soil and threatens his family's survival, Velu struggles with despair. An encounter with a wise village elder gives him deeper perspective on nature's cycles—reminding him that soil, like human beings, needs periods of forced rest to regenerate fertility. The story closes as cool evening winds bring the long-awaited monsoon rains.
